All 3 children complete. Epic criteria verified: cargo build/test succeed at the workspace root, justfile is the canonical developer+CI surface (just ci), and no_std enforcement for the leaf-shareable crates runs locally via just check-nostd against thumbv7em-none-eabihf and riscv32imc-unknown-none-elf.

signal crate landed: Value/Signal/Batch over a canonical CBOR profile, no_std+alloc, check-nostd green on both bare-metal targets. All acceptance criteria met and each new gate verified in the failing direction. Spec amendments landed in the same commit (e7a1995): ABI 6.3 value space closed, ABI 6.3.1 canonical form added with 11 rules and two documented RFC 8949 4.2.1 deviations, EXPR 2 float/map rows tightened. Follow-ups eieio-e6s.3 (typed decode errors) and eieio-e6s.4 (MAX_DEPTH configurability).

Property/round-trip suite and encoded-size accounting landed. Value/Signal/Batch::encoded_len is exact and computed structurally; 12 property tests cover round-trip, canonical fixed-point, length equality, and decoder totality over arbitrary bytes, CBOR-shaped bytes, mutations and truncations. Criterion 2's hand-written malformed-input cases were already delivered in e6s.1 and are strengthened here rather than duplicated. EXPR 9 MAX_VALUE_BYTES row amended in the same commit (d724591) to name the canonical encoding as the unit of measure. Follow-up eieio-e6s.5 filed.

Typed DecodeError landed (407f01a): one variant per ABI 6.3.1 rule, non_exhaustive, Display + core::error::Error, minicbor trait impls retained and bridged. All 52 rejection assertions converted from message substrings to variant matching, and proven discriminating by making two rules report the same variant. ABI 6.3.1 amended in the same commit to bound rejection-reason classification as diagnostic rather than normative.

Decided: configurable, recorded in ABI 6.3.1 rule 9 (0890aa0). Implemented as from_cbor_with_max_depth on Batch and Value with MIN_DEPTH floor clamping. The investigation also fixed a spec bug from e6s.1: rule 9 had required the bound be >= EXPR 9's reference default (128) rather than >= the host's configured expr MAX_DEPTH, which over-constrained exactly the leaf tier it was meant to protect.

Invariant documented and enforced (2a72fd4): every path from external bytes to a Value is depth-bounded, including the public minicbor Decode impls that bypass from_cbor. tests/depth.rs enforces it - pointing a trait impl at an unbounded decode aborts the test process, which is the hole it closes. Iterative impls rejected with evidence: impl Drop for Value fails E0509 and breaks Value destructuring this crate and expr both need, so Drop keeps recursing regardless and an iterative encoder would only move the crash.

All four epic acceptance criteria met and verified. (1) Value covers exactly the ABI 6.3 type space - all variants round-trip. (2) Signal is a text-keyed map, Batch an ordered array; the empty batch is legal and pins to 0x80. (3) minicbor round-trip encode/decode; crate is no_std + alloc and just check-nostd passes for both bare-metal targets, including the atomics-free riscv32imc. (4) Unit and property tests cover round-trips and edge cases - 52 tests across roundtrip/reject/properties/depth plus a doctest. Beyond the criteria the epic also produced ABI 6.3.1 (the normative canonical form, 11 rules with two documented RFC 8949 deviations), exact encoded-length accounting for EXPR 9's MAX_VALUE_BYTES, a typed DecodeError with a variant per rule, a host-configurable depth bound, and an enforced depth invariant. 5/5 children closed.

Lexer and parser landed (5abcf97 code+spec, 0104909 tests). Full EXPR 3.1 grammar with byte-offset spans on every node, ParseLimits floor-clamped per EXPR 9, the EXPR 8 error-code table, and the 5.2 let-shadowing check. EXPR 3.1 amended with a new 3.1.1 resolving seven ambiguities the grammar left open (letter=ASCII, the '-' tie-break, \u{1-6}, non-finite float literals, numbers running into symbols, one-expression-per-source, and parse-time budgets reporting PARSE). 36 tests, each rejection pinning code and span with an accepting near-miss alongside.
